The '''Tzorbi''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At some point, they established a medical [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] at their [[Tzorbi homeworld|homeworld]]. The Tzorbi eventually became one of the first species to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Remembering the Lost" /> which was [[Galactic Constitution Conference|founded]] in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before<ref name="Remembering the Lost" /> [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Remembering the Lost" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission, which occurs [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] after the extinction of the Tzorbi, must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> however, they became extinct, with the remains of some of the members of the species eventually becoming fossilized at their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Remembering the Lost" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to study the fossils of the Tzorbi. The latter individual collected samples of [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] traces from the [[Alien/Legends|aliens']] remains and also discovered their ancient laboratory.<ref name="Remembering the Lost" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tzorbi were mentioned in a Bionanalysis Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Remembering the Lost" />
